scenes.text: Did you know there is a fifty-square-mile strip of land in Yellowstone National Park where you could theoretically commit a major crime and walk away completely free?
Known as the Zone of Death, this area falls into a bizarre constitutional loophole because any federal jury must be selected from the state and district where the crime occurred.
Since this specific Idaho section of the park has a population of exactly zero, it is literally impossible to form a jury, meaning a legal trial cannot physically happen.

Even though the government knows about this terrifying loophole hiding inside America's most famous park, they still haven't fixed it, so tell me if you would ever dare to camp here and follow for more.

meta.title: The Only Place in America Where Crime is Legal #shorts
